rows.en: Touya: "It's been a while since we were last at the Holy Land."
Yamato: "It has. Wasn't the last time
just after Goderius came back, nyow?"
Ai: "Right. And then three Ze=Ode Spirit Mechs
Touya: "You haven't got a shred of tact, have you?"
Don't fight over someone like me. Please?"
Sorry, Ai. I went a little too far.
You don't have to worry about someone like me."
You don't have to let the past hold you back. You're you."
Or I'll start fighting with Ai again, you know?"
Ai: "S-saying that isn't going to get you anything from me!"
Touya: "What the hell?! I'm trying to apologize here!
Ai: "You're kidding! I can't believe you!
Who takes back what they said that easily?!"
Leone: "Hahahaha... You two really do get along.
I guess... I'm a little jealous."
Leone: "Don't be shy. You make a great couple."
Ai: "Y-you think so? Maybe you're actually pretty nice?"
Yamato: "You change your tune fast, nyow..."
Forzen: "Hello, everyone. You all look well."
You still love your cuddles, don't you, Miss Melvi?
Hm? Have you gotten a little heavier?"
Paldia: "Honestly, dear! How could you say that to a girl?"
Touya: "Can't we get even a moment's rest?!"
Paldia: "Melvi... Be home in time for dinner."

review_batches.context: Read all 71 rows. Holy Land return: Ai recalls three attackers, hurts Leone's feelings, Touya intervenes. Separate player-answer branches lead either to reassurance or renewed Touya/Ai quarrelling and Leone's teasing. Forzen/Paldia greet Melvi before Rayode interrupts.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the count of three, Leone's self-deprecation versus Touya's refusal to accept it, both unlabelled menu answers without adding speaker tags, apology/retort direction and nonsexual family affection. Do not combine mutually exclusive replies. Klau is an editorial food-name transliteration: species/ingredients remain unspecified. Pastry wrapping is explicit, not necessarily a sweet pie. Paldia's dinner threat conveys concern without turning the line into a literal combat guarantee. Silences, address-only reactions, interruptions and conventional exclamations retain fragments with row notes.
